title: get api v1 health returns service health status
description: Test the GET /api/v1/health endpoint to verify it returns a 200 status with {"status":"ok"} when the service is healthy, and returns a 500 status with error details when the service is degraded.

title: post api v1 ask returns rag generated answer with citations
description: Test the POST /api/v1/ask endpoint with a valid query and top_k parameter to ensure it returns a 200 status with an answer string and a list of citations containing source_id, chunk_id, snippet, and optional start_seconds and url fields.

title: post api v1 ask compares retrieval quality at top_k=2 vs top_k=5
description: Test POST /api/v1/ask with top_k=2 and top_k=5 across 7 questions (3 simple Python, 3 detailed Python, 1 off-topic refusal) using source_ids for the Python sources. For Q1–Q6 both calls must return 200 with a non-empty answer string and a citations list; use an LLM judge (gpt-4o-mini) to score each answer 1–5 and record which top_k setting wins. For Q7 (boiling point of water) both top_k=2 and top_k=5 must return a refusal answer. Print full answer text and sources for every question at both k values. Known Python source UUIDs: 038c02b0-f624-4e93-8959-562424a89c78 and 7cce7f29-993c-4a02-a9e5-28d2c774bbe5. Endpoint: POST /api/v1/ask with body {"query": "<question>", "source_ids": ["<uuid>"], "top_k": <2|5>}.
